description: Permanently deletes a Trello board by its ID. This is an irreversible action that removes the board and all its contents.

id.description: The unique identifier of the board to delete. Must be a valid Trello board ID.
id.title: Id

name: delete_board

DeleteBoardResponse.description:
Response schema for `DeleteBoard`

The DELETE /1/boards/{id} endpoint returns a 200 OK status code with an empty
response body upon successful deletion. No fields are returned in the response.
